name: Sakai
summary: A community-developed, open-source learning management system for universities and other education providers, with course delivery, assessment, collaboration and extensible tools.

value.freeTierNote: Yes. Sakai is open-source software with no licence fee; hosting, implementation and support may be chargeable.
value.trialNote: Open-source software can be downloaded and self-hosted; hosted support is offered by third parties

accessibility.finding: Public VPAT reports available for Sakai versions 21, 22 and 23. Community states goal of WCAG 2.2 A/AA; VPAT assessment methods include internal practitioner resources for at least Sakai 22.
accessibility.caveat: Strong public evidence; compare version-specific VPAT criteria and evaluation method before claiming full conformance.

value.from: Sakai core software: free (open-source); hosting and support quoted by service providers.
value.notes: No single SaaS price: deployment and support are provided by institutions or third-party service providers.

value.evidence: Deployment- and theme-dependent; obtain current ACR/VPAT from the institution or hosting provider. Sakai is open-source software; accessibility depends on release, theme, customisations and content. No universal product-level conformance claim entered.

security.notes: Deployment/operator dependent; no single central SaaS certification applies to all Sakai instances.

value.notes: Self-hosted or hosted by an institution/provider; location is determined by the operator. The institution or service provider operating the instance controls data processing, storage, backups and subprocessors.
No standard first-party foundation model identified; AI capability depends on institution-installed integrations/plugins and deployment configuration.
